description: Version-history panel for a file: lists versions newest-first with a current badge, compares a version with current (line diff), and restores a prior version via IFileVersioningHook.

parameters.name: ItemId
parameters.description: Identifier of the item whose versions are shown.

parameters.name: Hook
parameters.description: Versioning hook that supplies the history, diffs, and restore.

parameters.name: OnRestored
parameters.description: Raised after a version is restored so the host can refresh its listing.
